annotations.title: EVM token risk verdict & honeypot scan

description: Audit an EVM token contract on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, or Optimism for honeypot, sell-tax, proxy, and owner-privilege risks. Pass `chain` (`base`, `ethereum`, `arbitrum`, `optimism`) and 0x-prefixed 42-char `address` (required). Returns `risk_score` (0-100), `risk_band`, `flags[]`, tax percentages, and liquidity checks. Do not use for Solana SPL tokens (use check_solana_token_risk) or price history/indicators (use get_token_ohlc_indicators). 1 free try per IP, then HTTP 402 ($0.01 USDC).

session_token.description: Optional prepaid x402s_... session token from open_agent_session or https://apix402data.com/pay used after the 1 free try rolls over to HTTP 402.

timeout_ms.description: Optional deadline in ms. If the local LLM would exceed it, the response comes back fast with "degraded": true and non-LLM/cached data
